properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Run is enabled only after the full delay.
Loss of demand or safety permissive clears run and its timer.
No repeated count during continuous operation or stop.
A sustained permitted demand eventually starts under advancing time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.

atomic_propositions.delayDone: Permissive has continuously remained true for >=5s after its first sampled TRUE.
atomic_propositions.runPrev: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].BLOWER_RUN", "initial": false, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].BLOWER_RUN; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.countPrev: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT", "initial": 0, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or observed output.
atomic_propositions.TimeTick: Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.
atomic_propositions.BLOWER_RUN: O[k].BLOWER_RUN: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT: O[k].AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT: independently observed post-scan candidate value (UINT); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.BLOWER_RUN=false, O_init.AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT=0.
